plan.hypothesis: Reproduce the previously selected head/layer4 learning rates for six epochs.
plan.test_policy: Use original train for updates and original val for checkpoint selection; never load original test. No external sUAS data in training or selection.
plan.budget_note: Local CPU only, four threads. Previous layer4 epochs took roughly 80-105 seconds; retain an explicit cap and report actual completion.
plan.stopping_rule: At most 6 epochs, 2 non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 720 seconds checked between epochs.
plan.historical_selection_note: Learning rates were previously selected in the tracked development report. This run reproduces those settings; it does not rerun or independently revalidate the historical CV evidence.

compute.timing_scope: Run wall time includes setup, validation and checkpoint saving; excludes separate reload verification.
